question: Using RFC 9535 (JSONPath: Query Expressions for JSON) at https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9535.html, quote verbatim Figure 3 in Appendix A, the collected ABNF grammar of JSONPath Normalized Paths, including its comments.

facts.claim:
The rules `normalized-path` through `normal-unescaped`, verbatim (alignment and indentation are not graded):
normalized-path      = root-identifier *(normal-index-segment)
normal-index-segment = "[" normal-selector "]"
normal-selector      = normal-name-selector / normal-index-selector
normal-name-selector = %x27 *normal-single-quoted %x27 ; 'string'
normal-single-quoted = normal-unescaped /
                       ESC normal-escapable
normal-unescaped     =    ; omit %x0-1F control codes
                       %x20-26 /
                          ; omit 0x27 '
                       %x28-5B /
                          ; omit 0x5C \
                       %x5D-D7FF /
                          ; skip surrogate code points
                       %xE000-10FFFF
facts.evidence: source line 5842: "normalized-path      = root-identifier *(normal-index-segment)" (this part runs through line 5855; lines 5842-5855 contain no tags or entities and equal the quoted ABNF exactly; byte 296331 of 321191)

facts.claim:
The rules `normal-escapable` through `normal-index-selector`, verbatim (alignment and indentation are not graded):
normal-escapable     = %x62 / ; b BS backspace U+0008
                       %x66 / ; f FF form feed U+000C
                       %x6E / ; n LF line feed U+000A
                       %x72 / ; r CR carriage return U+000D
                       %x74 / ; t HT horizontal tab U+0009
                       "'" /  ; ' apostrophe U+0027
                       "\" /  ; \ backslash (reverse solidus) U+005C
                       (%x75 normal-hexchar)
                                       ; certain values u00xx U+00XX
normal-hexchar       = "0" "0"
                       (
                          ("0" %x30-37) / ; "00"-"07"
                             ; omit U+0008-U+000A BS HT LF
                          ("0" %x62) /    ; "0b"
                             ; omit U+000C-U+000D FF CR
                          ("0" %x65-66) / ; "0e"-"0f"
                          ("1" normal-HEXDIG)
                       )
normal-HEXDIG        = DIGIT / %x61-66    ; "0"-"9", "a"-"f"
normal-index-selector = "0" / (DIGIT1 *DIGIT)
                        ; non-negative decimal integer
facts.evidence: source line 5857: "normal-escapable = %x62 / ; b BS backspace U+0008" (the figure runs through line 5877, closed by on 5878 and captioned "Figure 3: Collected ABNF of JSONPath Normalized Paths"; lines 5857-5877 equal the quoted ABNF exactly)
